// Probe for tests/unit/document-gate-before-model.test.ts — GREEN. The
// extraction input is built by the gate's own constructor from a verdict.
import { validateDocumentForIngestion } from "@/lib/ingestion/document-gate"
import { toValidatedAIDocument } from "@/lib/ingestion/validated-document"
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"

export async function gatedProbe(bytes: Buffer, userId: string) {
    const verdict = await validateDocumentForIngestion({
        bytes, canonicalMime: "application/pdf", declaredBranch: null, declaredBranchSource: "user",
        mode: "policy", surface: "bulk_extract", actorUserId: userId, ownerUserId: userId,
    })
    if (verdict.status !== "validated") return null
    return getAIService().extractPolicyData(toValidatedAIDocument(verdict, bytes, "application/pdf"))
}
